title: S01T03 - Complete provenance, dependency, secret, and repository-boundary audit
description: Validate dependency and prior-art provenance, scan secrets and machine-specific paths, and identify tracker, memory, dump, generated, or history content that must not ship. Document the current license state without selecting, replacing, or applying a new license.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated secret and dependency-license scans pass, and every excluded or sanitized path is documented with its reason.
The prior-art and AI-assisted authorship provenance review records concrete risks and follow-up boundaries.
The current license state is documented and remains unchanged.
All repository changes are captured in scoped Git checkpoint commits or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health diagnostics are run before closeout.

dirtyPathNotes: git_unavailable: release audit, documentation, tests, and tracker files remain uncommitted because the managed session denies creation of .git/index.lock

closedReason: Provenance, dependency, secret, repository, package, and unchanged-license boundaries are now documented and machine-checked.
